default-1080p.label: OW2 spectator scoreboard (Tab) · 1920x1080
default-1080p.description: Observer 3 keeps the in-game scoreboard (Tab) open. All regions are on the 1920x1080 grid; other 16:9 sizes are scaled to it. Measured from the ISU spectator screenshot 2026-10-05.

teams.label: Top team (left / blue side of the board)

name.label: Player name
name.note: names are italic (BigNoodleTooOblique); shear straightens them before OCR. threshold 185 (only pixels brighter than this are text): names are pure white, but a bright team colour behind them (teal ~120-140) sat right on the old 120 cut-off and turned the name box to noise

ultimateRing.note: ring centre x on the 1080p grid and y relative to the row centre; fills clockwise from 12 o'clock. The ult % sits inside it (x 661-676).

default-1080p.layoutNote: barLeft = left end of the light header bar above the top team (x on the 1080p grid). Auto-align compares the live bar with it: perks push the left block (portrait, ult, name) ~50 px left and the stat columns ~50 px right; the stat columns are read from the header labels.
